page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6a.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture AMD EPYC 7H12 processor running at 2.6 GHz. The instance provides 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs, with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place the ecs.g6a.4xlarge in the average tier for most multi-core and processing workloads. While single-core stress-ng performance is positioned in the bottom 10%, multi-core CPU execution, Geekbench multi-core scores, and Passmark CPU tests consistently register in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests show a divergence: small-block cached reads perform at an average level, whereas large-block uncached read and write operations fall into the bottom 25%. Standard operations like Redis SET, static web serving, and Gzip compression operate within average performance parameters.

From a resource density perspective, the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers a balanced hardware profile suitable for general-purpose workloads. Given its average multi-core performance and lack of local storage, it is well-suited for applications such as web serving, database operations, and general-purpose application hosting where extreme single-core performance or high-speed local disk access is not a primary requirement.
